public_rationale: The evidence supports concerns about review effort, but not the full causal chain. Sonar found differing experiences, including developers reporting less effort. Meta measured a slowdown in one workflow and no detectable regression after changing it. Those results caution against 'guaranteeing', but their scope does not settle how commonly contemporary generated code violates company standards or causes skimming and delegated review.
limitations: The survey measures reported effort, not controlled review time.
The Meta experiment concerns suggested fixes to review comments.
No single study tests all links in the asserted chain.

from_speaker: rarely aligns with in-house coding guidelines and standards
guaranteeing that it’ll take far longer to chew through
reviewing it will either skim-read it or feed it into another LLM
our_interpretation: The plain reading is a broad causal claim about professional review of LLM-generated code as of publication.
'Often' requires recurring prevalence, and 'rarely aligns' means compliance is uncommon. Neither supplies a precise frequency.
'Far longer' concerns materially greater review time for comparable work, not simply more total review work because more code is produced.
The proposed causal chain must connect verbosity and standards failures to review time and then to skimming or LLM delegation.
A small study of targeted patches can test inevitability in that setting, but cannot establish the prevalence of problems across contemporary generated code.
criteria.support_condition: Representative comparisons must find frequent verbosity, uncommon compliance with actual local standards and substantially longer review for comparable changes, with evidence that these problems cause reviewers to skim or delegate review.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Representative comparisons showing ordinary compliance and no substantial review penalty would contradict the general claim. Comparable observed workflows preserving thorough human review would rebut the claimed inevitable downstream behavior.
